subject.title: [Feature]: Add realtime video frame transport for provider and gateway relay sessions

question: Should OpenClaw accept gateway/provider transport of camera-derived frames for realtime Talk, and what consent, validation, logging, and public API contract should that transport require?
rationale: This changes a sensitive camera-data boundary and public gateway/plugin contracts, so automation cannot choose the product/security policy safely.

options.title: Approve A Narrow Gated Contract
options.body: Define a one-shot frame contract with explicit consent assumptions, size/MIME validation, redaction/logging rules, provider retention notes, and additive RPC/bridge tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep Browser-Direct Only For Now
options.body: Limit visual context to the draft browser-direct path and leave gateway/provider frame transport out until there is clearer demand or a safer API shape.

options.title: Defer Or Decline Relay Frame Transport
options.body: Close or defer this transport direction if maintainers decide camera frames should not transit Gateway/provider plugin boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve A Narrow Gated Contract
recommendation.body: Define a one-shot frame contract with explicit consent assumptions, size/MIME validation, redaction/logging rules, provider retention notes, and additive RPC/bridge tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and current-main history ties him to the central Talk/Gateway contract shape.
